summary: Correct the affiliation count in OVR-000398.
why: OVR-000398 says the paper cell run-04 hit the refusal on six ResearchContributor entities carrying affiliation as a one-item list. Five carry a one-item list and person:yu-zhiteng carries three, verified on 2026-09-05 from the run's own population file. The defect, the fix and the guard are unchanged: a tuple reached the ontology validator, which accepts only a list for a multivalued slot, and the three-item value refused for the same reason as the five. Only the count in the why is wrong. The superseded block pins four documents, so this correction requires a replacement that re-pins them under the exact sentence.
